fields.acceptance: daemon-request-slot.txtar with a fake rex: with max-runs 2, two ready change sets and no request, daemon --once starts both ship runs; with one queued request and max-runs 1 it starts one ship run and the request stays queued; with max-runs 2 it starts one ship run and the request's plan run, and daemon status shows the other change set as no-slot with 'waiting for a slot: one is kept for a queued plan request'
fields.statement: While a queued plan request could start (no run, its retry time passed) and max-runs is above 1, the daemon's ship picks take at most max-runs minus 1 slots, so one is left for the request's plan run; a ready change set held back by this shows in daemon status as no-slot with the detail 'waiting for a slot: one is kept for a queued plan request'. With max-runs 1, or no request waiting, picks are unchanged

While a plan request waits, the daemon keeps one run slot for it: ship picks fill at most max-runs minus 1 slots. Owner, 2026-11-03: "I just filed one that I want moved to the top of the queue" and "yes, raise it to 3"; the request still got no slot because the new slot went to another ship run
fields.wording: the owner's words; the slot rule is the orchestrator's, as the owner's proxy
